```{r}
# SCRIPT COMPLETO - COMPARACIÓN CELULAR POR FENOTIPO Y TIPO DE CÉLULA

# LIBRERÍAS
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(nortest)
library(FSA)
library(multcomp)
library(openxlsx)

# CARGAR DATOS

data <- types_combined_FILTERED

# EXTRAER ID DE MUESTRA (ej. de 2PEL1_3_invert.tif --> 2PEL1)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_extract(Name, "^[^_]+"))

# AGRUPAR Y PROMEDIAR POR MUESTRA Y TIPO CELULAR
vars_to_summarise <- c("Area", "Circularity", "Max_diameter", "Min_diameter")
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vars_to_summarise), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# RECUENTO DE CÉLULAS POR MUESTRA Y TIPO CELULAR
cell_counts <- data %>%
  group_by(Name, Sample_ID, Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(Cell_Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Cell_Count = mean(Cell_Count), .groups = "drop")

# JUNTAR RECUENTOS Y PROMEDIOS
combined_data <- left_join(summary_data, cell_counts,
                           by = c("Sample_ID", "Phenotype", "Cellular_Type"))

# CREAR VARIABLE DE GRUPO PARA ANÁLISIS (ej. PEL_NORMAL_TYPE1)
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(Grupo = paste(Phenotype, Cellular_Type, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(Grupo = factor(Grupo))

# FUNCIÓN PARA ESTADÍSTICA
analyze_variable <- function(df, variable, group_col = "Grupo") {
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[variable]]))
  formula <- as.formula(paste(variable, "~", group_col))

  # Normalidad por grupo
  normality <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      shapiro_p = ifelse(n > 3, shapiro.test(.data[[variable]])$p.value, NA),
      ad_p = ifelse(n > 7, ad.test(.data[[variable]])$p.value, NA),
      normal = ifelse(!is.na(shapiro_p) && shapiro_p > 0.05, TRUE,
                      ifelse(!is.na(ad_p) && ad_p > 0.05, TRUE, FALSE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Homogeneidad
  levene <- broom::tidy(leveneTest(formula, data = df))

  # Elegir prueba
  if (all(normality$normal, na.rm = TRUE) && levene$p.value[1] > 0.05) {
    modelo <- aov(formula, data = df)
    tukey <- glht(modelo, linfct = mcp(Grupo = "Tukey"))
    posthoc <- data.frame(summary(tukey)$test[c("pvalues", "tstat")])
    posthoc$Comparison <- rownames(summary(tukey)$test$coefficients)
    posthoc$Metodo <- "Tukey"
    test_global <- summary(modelo)[[1]]
    test_type <- "ANOVA"
    test_stat <- test_global$`F value`[1]
    test_p <- test_global$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  } else {
    kruskal <- kruskal.test(formula, data = df)
    dunn <- dunnTest(formula, data = df, method = "bonferroni")$res
    posthoc <- dunn
    posthoc$Metodo <- "Dunn"
    test_type <- "Kruskal-Wallis"
    test_stat <- kruskal$statistic
    test_p <- kruskal$p.value
  }

  posthoc <- posthoc %>%
    mutate(Significativo = ifelse(P.adj < 0.05, "Sí", "No"))

  list(
    normality = normality,
    homogeneity = levene,
    test_global = data.frame(Variable = variable, Metodo = test_type, Estadistico = test_stat, p.valor = test_p),
    posthoc = posthoc
  )
}

# APLICAR A TODAS LAS VARIABLES
variables <- c("Area", "Circularity", "Max_diameter", "Min_diameter", "Mean_Cell_Count")
normalidad_list <- list()
homogeneity_list <- list()
test_global_list <- list()
posthoc_list <- list()

for (v in variables) {
  r <- analyze_variable(combined_data, v)
  normalidad_list[[v]] <- r$normality %>% mutate(Variable = v)
  homogeneity_list[[v]] <- r$homogeneity %>% mutate(Variable = v)
  test_global_list[[v]] <- r$test_global
  posthoc_list[[v]] <- r$posthoc %>% mutate(Variable = v)
}

# COMBINAR TODO
df_normalidad <- bind_rows(normalidad_list)
df_levene <- bind_rows(homogeneity_list)
df_test_global <- bind_rows(test_global_list)
df_posthoc <- bind_rows(posthoc_list)

# GUARDAR RESULTADOS EN EXCEL
write.xlsx(
  list(
    Recuento_Promedio_Celulas = combined_data,
    Supuestos_Normalidad = df_normalidad,
    Supuestos_Levene = df_levene,
    Test_Global = df_test_global,
    Comparaciones_PostHoc = df_posthoc
  ),
  file = "RESULTADOS_CELLULAR_ANALYSIS.xlsx"
)

```


```{r}
# Librerías necesarias
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(nortest)
library(car)
library(openxlsx)
library(broom)

# Leer datos
data <- types_combined_FILTERED

# Extraer ID biológico eliminando el sufijo de la imagen
# Ejemplo: "2PEL1_3_invert.tif" -> "2PEL1"
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Biol_Sample_ID = sub("_\\\\[^_]+_invert\\\.tif$", "", Name))

# Verificar variables numéricas
numeric_vars <- c("Area", "Circularity", "Max_diameter", "Min_diameter")

# Agrupar por muestra biológica y tipo celular y calcular promedios
summary_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Biol_Sample_ID, Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(numeric_vars), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            Cell_Count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Exportar tabla resumida (datos promediados por muestra)
write_csv(summary_data, "summary_data_by_sample.csv")

# Comparaciones: NORMAL vs MUTANT dentro de cada fenotipo
comparisons_norm_mut <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(Phenotype) %>%
  group_split()

# Comparaciones: PEL vs WT dentro de cada tipo celular
comparisons_pel_wt <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(Cellular_Type) %>%
  group_split()

# Funciones para estadística y visualización
evaluate_and_plot <- function(df, group_col, group_levels, var_name, out_prefix) {
  df[[group_col]] <- factor(df[[group_col]], levels = group_levels)
  formula <- reformulate(group_col, response = var_name)

  # Test de normalidad
  normality <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              shapiro_p = ifelse(n > 3, shapiro.test(.data[[var_name]])$p.value, NA),
              ad_p = ifelse(n > 7, ad.test(.data[[var_name]])$p.value, NA),
              normal = ifelse(!is.na(shapiro_p) && shapiro_p > 0.05, TRUE,
                               ifelse(!is.na(ad_p) && ad_p > 0.05, TRUE, FALSE)),
              .groups = "drop")

  # Test de homogeneidad
  levene_result <- broom::tidy(leveneTest(formula, data = df))

  # Kruskal-Wallis
  kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(formula, data = df)

  # Graficar
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = group_col, y = var_name, fill = group_col)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label.y = max(df[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle(paste("Comparación de", var_name, "por", group_col))

  ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, "_", var_name, ".png"), p, width = 7, height = 5)

  return(list(
    normality = normality,
    levene = levene_result,
    kruskal = tidy(kruskal_result),
    plot = p
  ))
}

# Aplicar a todas las variables para cada comparación
test_results <- list()

# NORMAL vs MUTANT dentro de cada fenotipo
for (group in comparisons_norm_mut) {
  phenotype <- unique(group$Phenotype)
  for (v in numeric_vars) {
    res <- evaluate_and_plot(group, "Cellular_Type", c("NORMAL_TYPE1", "MUTANT_TYPE2"), v,
                             out_prefix = paste0("comparison_Normal_vs_Mutant_", phenotype))
    test_results[[paste("Norm_vs_Mut", phenotype, v, sep = "_")]] <- res
  }
}

# PEL vs WT dentro de cada tipo celular
for (group in comparisons_pel_wt) {
  celltype <- unique(group$Cellular_Type)
  for (v in numeric_vars) {
    res <- evaluate_and_plot(group, "Phenotype", c("PEL", "WT"), v,
                             out_prefix = paste0("comparison_PEL_vs_WT_", celltype))
    test_results[[paste("PEL_vs_WT", celltype, v, sep = "_")]] <- res
  }
}

# Exportar resultados estadísticos a Excel
wb <- createWorkbook()

for (name in names(test_results)) {
  res <- test_results[[name]]
  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(name, "_normality"))
  writeData(wb, sheet = paste0(name, "_normality"), res$normality)

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(name, "_levene"))
  writeData(wb, sheet = paste0(name, "_levene"), res$levene)

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0(name, "_kruskal"))
  writeData(wb, sheet = paste0(name, "_kruskal"), res$kruskal)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "estadisticas_completas_por_variable.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Librerías
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(nortest)
library(car)
library(FSA)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggsignif)
library(broom)

# Leer datos
data <- read_csv("types_combined_FILTERED.csv")

# Extraer muestra base
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Muestra = sub("_.*", "", Name)
  )

# Paso 1: Agregación por imagen (Name)
por_imagen <- data %>%
  group_by(Name, Muestra, Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    N_cells = n(),
    Area = mean(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    Circularity = mean(Circularity, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_diameter = mean(Max_diameter, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_diameter = mean(Min_diameter, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Paso 2: Agregación por muestra base
por_muestra <- por_imagen %>%
  group_by(Muestra, Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    N_cells = mean(N_cells),
    Area = mean(Area),
    Circularity = mean(Circularity),
    Max_diameter = mean(Max_diameter),
    Min_diameter = mean(Min_diameter),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Para análisis posterior, combinamos variables morfométricas
long_data <- por_muestra %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = Area:Min_diameter, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Valor")

# Crear estructuras para exportar
resumen_global <- list()
resultados_globales <- data.frame()
posthoc_list <- list()
signif_list <- list()
supuestos_normalidad <- list()
supuestos_levene <- list()

# Comparaciones deseadas
comparaciones_deseadas <- list(
  PEL = list(
    groups = c("PEL_NORMAL", "PEL_MUTANT"),
    data = filter(por_muestra, Phenotype == "PEL")
  ),
  WT = list(
    groups = c("WT_NORMAL", "WT_MUTANT"),
    data = filter(por_muestra, Phenotype == "WT")
  ),
  TYPE = list(
    groups = c("PEL_NORMAL", "WT_NORMAL", "PEL_MUTANT", "WT_MUTANT"),
    data = por_muestra
  )
)

# Unir grupo por columnas auxiliares
por_muestra <- por_muestra %>%
  mutate(Grupo = paste(Phenotype, gsub("TYPE", "", Cellular_Type), sep = "_"))

# Función asteriscos
asteriscos <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("n.s.")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("n.s.")
}

# Análisis por variable y comparación
for (var in c("Area", "Circularity", "Max_diameter", "Min_diameter")) {
  for (test_name in names(comparaciones_deseadas)) {
    grupo <- comparaciones_deseadas[[test_name]]$groups
    datos <- comparaciones_deseadas[[test_name]]$data
    datos_var <- datos %>% filter(Grupo %in% grupo)
    formula <- reformulate("Grupo", response = var)
    
    # Normalidad
    norm_data <- datos_var %>%
      group_by(Grupo) %>%
      summarise(
        Shapiro = ifelse(n() >= 3, shapiro.test(.data[[var]])$p.value, NA),
        AD = ifelse(n() >= 7, ad.test(.data[[var]])$p.value, NA),
        Normal = ifelse(!is.na(Shapiro) && Shapiro > 0.05, TRUE,
                        ifelse(!is.na(AD) && AD > 0.05, TRUE, FALSE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    supuestos_normalidad[[paste0(var, "_", test_name)]] <- norm_data

    # Homogeneidad
    lev <- leveneTest(formula, data = datos_var)
    supuestos_levene[[paste0(var, "_", test_name)]] <- tidy(lev)

    # Test global
    normal_all <- all(norm_data$Normal, na.rm = TRUE)
    homog <- tidy(lev)$p.value[1] > 0.05

    if (normal_all && homog) {
      modelo <- aov(formula, data = datos_var)
      resultado <- summary(modelo)[[1]]
      test <- "ANOVA"
      ph <- TukeyHSD(modelo)
      ph_df <- as.data.frame(ph[[1]]) %>%
        rownames_to_column("Comparison") %>%
        mutate(Metodo = "Tukey", Variable = var)
    } else {
      modelo <- kruskal.test(formula, data = datos_var)
      test <- "Kruskal"
      ph_df <- dunnTest(formula, data = datos_var, method = "bonferroni")$res %>%
        mutate(Metodo = "Dunn", Variable = var)
    }

    # Significancia
    ph_df$Significancia <- sapply(ph_df$P.adj, asteriscos)
    posthoc_list[[paste0(var, "_", test_name)]] <- ph_df

    # Gráfico
    gg <- ggplot(datos_var, aes(x = Grupo, y = .data[[var]], fill = Grupo)) +
      geom_violin(alpha = 0.3, trim = TRUE) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = paste0("Comparación: ", test_name, " – ", var), y = var, x = "") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      stat_compare_means(comparisons = combn(grupo, 2, simplify = FALSE), method = "t.test", label = "p.signif")
    
    ggsave(paste0("PLOT_", test_name, "_", var, ".svg"), plot = gg, width = 6, height = 5)
    ggsave(paste0("PLOT_", test_name, "_", var, ".jpg"), plot = gg, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  }
}

# Gráfico de barras (conteo de células por grupo)
barra <- por_muestra %>%
  group_by(Phenotype, Cellular_Type) %>%
  summarise(Promedio_celulas = mean(N_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Phenotype, y = Promedio_celulas, fill = Cellular_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(title = "Número promedio de células por tipo", y = "Número de células", x = "") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("CELL_COUNTS_BAR.svg", barra, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave("CELL_COUNTS_BAR.jpg", barra, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

# Exportar a Excel
write.xlsx(
  list(
    Supuestos_Normalidad = bind_rows(supuestos_normalidad, .id = "Variable"),
    Supuestos_Levene = bind_rows(supuestos_levene, .id = "Variable"),
    PostHoc = bind_rows(posthoc_list, .id = "Variable"),
    Por_Imagen = por_imagen,
    Por_Muestra = por_muestra
  ),
  file = "RESULTADOS_ANALISIS_TIPOS_CELULAS.xlsx"
)

```
